entries.zh: 紧密、密实、密集（收拢得紧实细密）
entries.en: to pack tight, be dense and closely packed

entries.zh: 咬牙、咬紧牙齿作声（磨牙）
entries.en: to clench or grind the teeth, gnashing

entries.zh: 催促收紧、勒紧（绳结收牢）；第二字或为「系（繫）」
entries.en: to tighten, pull tight (as a knot); urge it tight
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注疑字（紧/繫），取「催促收紧」义，与西语「绳结收紧」相合。

entries.zh: 心口、内心；心头憋闷郁结（西语注「心内憋闷」）
entries.en: constricted in the heart, anguished; the inner heart, one's feelings

entries.zh: 夹住、钳夹（从两旁夹紧）
entries.en: to pinch or clamp (something) between, press tight from both sides

entries.zh: 夹起来（拾起收存）
entries.en: to pick up by pinching and put away, save

entries.zh: 抓起一块攥在手里（拿起并捏紧）
entries.en: to take hold of (a piece of) something and squeeze it

entries.zh: 碰破、按破（按压致皮肉破损）
entries.en: to break or burst (the skin) by pressing, squeeze till it breaks
entries.notes: 西语「挤压皮肤」与汉字「触破（碰破）」非直译，取「按压致破」为两栏共义。

entries.zh: 顶住、抵靠；又相抵、抵至
entries.en: to press or push against, butt against; also to reach
entries.notes: 西语词头「apretarse conocido」文义有讹，官话对音与「抵」仅粗合，取「顶抵」义存疑。

entries.zh: 抵住、顶着（西语注：以指按鼻孔、以指点物）
entries.en: to press against with the finger (press the nostrils), point with the finger

entries.zh: 把它压紧、扣紧（如扣紧帽盖）
entries.en: to press it very tight, as one presses a cap
entries.notes: 首字有疑（算/转），依西语「如帽盖般用力压紧」取「压紧」义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕

entries.zh: 经常、照常；西语词头（prisa、presto、diligente、apriessa）义为赶急、迅速、勤快
entries.en: haste; quickly, promptly; diligent (prisa, presto, diligente, apriessa)
entries.notes: 西语词头表「急速勤快」而汉字栏仅「常」，两栏对合不直观，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕

entries.zh: 着急、气恼、气喘急促（西语词头「准备那样东西」与汉字栏不相应）
entries.en: preparing, making that ready (preparando aquello)
entries.notes: 西语词头与汉字「气急」各自成义、互不相证，对合存疑。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 仅西语栏存「Apropriasse la cabeça」（约「凑近其头」），汉字与双音栏尽缺，无从释义。

entries.zh: 录取、录中；经考核而核准
entries.en: to approve by examination; pass and be admitted

entries.zh: 准许、许可（西语注「核准并查验」）
entries.en: to permit, allow; to approve and examine

entries.zh: 准许、批准
entries.en: to permit, grant approval

entries.zh: 批阅点定、圈点批改试卷；考试核准
entries.en: to grade and mark the examinations; pass or approve the exams
entries.notes: 首字有疑（批/拟），取「批点＝阅卷点定」义。

entries.zh: 科考及第、中式（西语注「核准其科第功名」）
entries.en: to pass the examination and obtain the degree

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕

entries.zh: 释义存疑：西语词头义为「占取他人劳作之利」，汉字「述」与对音难以互证，疑字有讹
entries.en: to profit from another's work (Spanish headword; Chinese gloss undetermined)
entries.notes: 汉字「述」与闽南对音及西语语义无法互证，疑字有讹，释义未能定夺。

entries.zh: 转述他人的话、传人言语
entries.en: to repeat or make use of what another person says
entries.notes: 第三字有疑（咀/呾），取「述人嘴话＝转述人言」义，与西语相合。

entries.zh: 功效、成效（劳作见效；西语词头涉医者，尾部文义有讹）
entries.en: efficacy, effect; the work proves useful (especially of the physician's craft)
entries.notes: 西语词头尾部「donde el medico suena」文义不清，取汉字与双音一致的「功效」义。
